title: How a Sink P-Trap Seals Out Sewer Gas
description: A standard P-trap is designed to retain a standing column of water in its lower dip after every drain cycle. This standing water seal serves as a continuous physical barrier, stopping foul sewer gases from escaping through the fixture drain into living spaces. As new wastewater enters through the sink tailpiece, it displaces the existing water in the trap curve, flushing away debris while constantly renewing the liquid seal. Maintaining correct trap geometry prevents dry traps and keeps sewer gas locked underground.
